title: AccidentSim: Generating Vehicle Collision Videos with Physically Realistic Collision Trajectories from Real-World Accident Reports
abstract: arXiv:2503.20654v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Collecting real-world vehicle accident videos for autonomous driving research is challenging due to their rarity and complexity. While existing driving video generation methods may produce visually realistic videos, they often fail to deliver physically realistic simulations because they lack the capability to generate accurate post-collision trajectories. In this paper, we introduce AccidentSim, a novel framework that generates physically realistic vehicle collision videos by extracting and utilizing the physical clues and contextual information available in real-world vehicle accident reports. Specifically, AccidentSim leverages a reliable physical simulator to replicate post-collision vehicle trajectories from the physical and contextual information in the accident reports and to build a vehicle collision trajectory dataset. translated_title: AccidentSim：从真实世界事故报告中生成具有物理真实碰撞轨迹的车辆碰撞视频
translated_abstract: 由于真实世界车辆事故视频的稀缺性和复杂性，为自动驾驶研究收集这些视频极具挑战性。虽然现有的驾驶视频生成方法可以产生视觉上逼真的视频，但由于缺乏生成准确碰撞后轨迹的能力，它们往往无法提供物理上逼真的模拟。在本文中，我们提出了AccidentSim，这是一个新颖的框架，通过提取和利用真实世界车辆事故报告中可用的物理线索和上下文信息，生成物理上逼真的车辆碰撞视频。具体来说，AccidentSim利用可靠的物理模拟器，从事故报告中的物理和上下文信息中复现碰撞后的车辆轨迹，并构建车辆碰撞轨迹数据集。然后使用该数据集对语言模型进行微调，使其能够响应用户提示……
tldr: AccidentSim通过从真实事故报告中提取物理线索和上下文信息，利用物理模拟器构建碰撞轨迹数据集并微调语言模型，从而生成具有物理真实碰撞轨迹的车辆碰撞视频。
en_tdlr: AccidentSim generates physically realistic vehicle collision videos by extracting physical clues and contextual information from real-world accident reports, leveraging a physical simulator to build a collision trajectory dataset for fine-tuning a language model.
